claim: Someone who has only seen ten-second clips will believe DemoKit can carry a whole task — a reviewer moving through a pull request, back out to the queue, into another one, and down to the diff — without a cut, and prove every screen it claimed to reach along the way.
_ledger: S0  a merged pull request on vercel/next.js, conversation tab  <- where the viewer starts
S1  the commits that went into it                              <- click Commits
S2  its diff, sixteen files                                    <- click Files changed
S3  back to the discussion, reviewers and labels                <- click Conversation
S4  the issue tracker, 999 of them                              <- click Issues
S5  the pull request queue, 2.3k of them                        <- click Pull requests
S6  whatever is at the top of the queue right now               <- click the first row
S8  its diff, line by line                                      <- click Files changed

steps.label: open the commits
steps.shows: every commit that went into this pull request

steps.label: back to the discussion
steps.shows: the review thread, its reviewers and its labels

steps.label: out to the review queue
steps.shows: every open pull request, newest first

steps.label: open whatever is at the top today
steps.shows: a pull request nobody chose in advance - this is a live queue

steps.label: down to the diff
steps.shows: the change itself, line by line
